segments.text: Tangle. 3D billboard ads that pass the street-view test.
Brands pay for the city's best corner to run a 3D ad. But the effect only works if the screen geometry is exact. A few degrees off, and launch night looks broken.
With Tangle, you give the brief and the real screen. Gemini 4 Argon builds the 3D scene.
We simulate exactly what someone on the street sees, and an independent checker measures it.
Here the real corner is {true_angle} degrees, not 90. The error is {c2_max_v1} degrees, over the {c2_max_limit} limit. Fail.
Argon watches the street-view video, reads the report and proposes a fix. Argon proposes; the checker decides.
The error drops to {c2_max_best} degrees. Still over the limit, so no certificate.
You get the screen files, the street-view proof, and a certificate only when every check passes.
Digital screens are half of outdoor advertising. Tangle makes them provable. Built today at the Gemini 4 Argon hackathon.
